title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Coliseum on 1973-06-22
taper: Main source discs provided by Andy Lemieux.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture featuring an astonishing "The Other One" and a variable, intensely charged performance.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the powerful rendition of "The Other One," calling it one of the most astonishing performances they've heard. The recording is praised for its great sound quality, likely a clean sound‑board source. Overall the show is described as variable and intense, delivering high energy throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Single enthusiastic 5‑star review highlights both a stellar performance (especially "The Other One") and excellent sound quality, leading to a high rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes "Great Sound," indicating a clear, well‑balanced capture typical of soundboard recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Variable pacing with intense moments throughout the set.
